fusions.name: Devour the Wound
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A strike that deals 8 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at 2.5 tiles, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Laid Table
fusions.desc: A sweeping plated blow that deals 26 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles long. If it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you, and your physical resistance rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Full Belly Bulwark
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
